payload.purpose_context: This mission builds the read-only Ops screen (sk-ops-screen) for the project's Op invocation records against the Mission Status contract, so the app shell's Ops item shows real data.
payload.purpose_tldr: Ops screen against the Mission Status contract

payload.wp_title: Contract slice check, Ops fixtures and gate baseline
Ops defaults, pure logic and the data-driven and R-ops-1 gates
Foundation spikes S-O1 to S-O4 and CP-1 evidence
Foundation: skeleton, exceptions wiring and the surface freeze
Rows: head, badge, facts and inert evidence (chain X)
Paging and notices: header, count, Load more, skipped and load-more error (chain Y)
States: loading, empty, error, live region and focus proof (chain Y)
Integration, baselines, timings and wrap-up inputs
